title: Image-Verapamil SR in Adults with Type 1 Diabetes (Image-VER-A-T1D)
official: A GLP-1 receptor PET imaging add-on study within the VERA-T1D trial investigating the effects on beta cell mass (Image-VER-A-T1D)
summary: Main objective: To measure pancreatic uptake of 68Ga-NODAGA-exendin by PET/CT for detection of intra-individual differences in beta cell mass before and after treatment and inter-individual differences between the treatment group and the placebo group.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Are included in the VER-A-T1D trial, but have not  started treatment/placebo.
2. have given written informed consent.
3. Age ≥18 years at consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. Treatment with synthetic exendin (Exentide,  Byetta®) or dipeptidyl-peptidase IV inhibitors (to  exclude interferences with imaging), specifically  mentioned although in principle part of exclusion  criteria VER-A-T1D.
2. Renal disease defined as MDRD < 40  ml/min/1.73m²
3. Pregnancy or the wish to become pregnant within  2 months after second PET/CT scan.
